_doc: Smallest independently improvable + judgeable pieces. 'owns' = files the builder may change freely; anything else only with a minimal, additive hook. 'scenario' = what the on-device critic must capture. 'refs' = what the blind reference images must show.

pieces.title: Car body & silhouette
pieces.scenario: Showroom/studio: sylph_s2, rotora_fd, titan_rz, hachi_gt at front 3/4, side profile, rear 3/4, and a low front close-up; also the car as seen in the title screen and in free roam chase view (daylight). HUD off.
pieces.refs: GT7 Brand Central / Scapes and FH5 Autoshow/photo-mode shots of JDM cars of the same archetype (S15 Silvia, RX-7 FD, Supra A80, AE86) at matching angles.

pieces.title: Car paint, glass & materials
pieces.scenario: Showroom close-ups and outdoor daylight: gloss, metallic, pearl, matte, chrome finishes; glass, lamp lenses, trim, carbon, rubber. Reflections and clearcoat highlights must be visible.
pieces.refs: GT7 Scapes paint close-ups and FH5 photo-mode paint/reflection close-ups.

pieces.title: Wheels, tyres & brakes
pieces.scenario: Showroom wheel close-ups (several rim designs), tyre sidewall and tread, brake disc/caliper behind spokes; wheel fitment in the arch from side profile; wheel at speed in chase view.
pieces.refs: GT7 / FH5 close-ups of wheels, tyres, brakes and wheel-arch fitment.

pieces.title: Driving cameras
pieces.scenario: Free roam, daylight, touge + expressway: frame sequences (straight at speed, turn-in, mid-corner, hard braking, drift, collision) in chase near/far, hood, bumper and cockpit modes. HUD off for framing shots.
pieces.refs: FH5 and GT7 gameplay frames from the same camera modes and situations.

pieces.title: Driving HUD
pieces.scenario: Free roam driving at speed, day and night: full frame with HUD plus crops of speedo/tach, gear/shift light, boost, assists; legibility at 1334x750 on a 4.7" screen.
pieces.refs: FH5 and GT7 in-race HUD screenshots (speedo/tach cluster, gear, shift light).

pieces.title: Daylight sky, sun & colour grade
pieces.scenario: Free roam, clear weather, HUD off, chase view: touge and city at 08:00, 12:00 and 17:30 golden hour; one wide vista looking toward the sun.
pieces.refs: FH5 / FH4 / GT7 daylight and golden-hour gameplay or photo-mode shots with visible sky.

pieces.title: Road surface & roadside furniture
pieces.scenario: Free roam daylight, HUD off: low camera over the asphalt, chase view on touge (guardrails, curbs, markings, verges) and on expressway.
pieces.refs: GT7 track-surface close-ups and FH5 road shots (asphalt detail, markings, curbs, barriers).

pieces.title: World scenery: terrain, foliage, buildings, props
pieces.scenario: Free roam daylight vistas, HUD off: each district (city, expressway, docks, rural, coast, touge); roadside at driving speed.
pieces.refs: FH5 scenery and FH6 Japan trailer stills; GT7 Scapes of Japanese locations.

pieces.title: Night lighting: streetlights, headlights, neon
pieces.scenario: Free roam 21:00 clear, HUD off: city streets, expressway, touge in headlights; oncoming traffic lights; rear view of car tail lamps.
pieces.refs: FH5 night driving and GT7 Tokyo Expressway night shots.

pieces.title: Rain & wet road
pieces.scenario: Free roam heavy rain day and night, HUD off: road reflections, puddles, spray behind cars, rain particles, windscreen in cockpit view.
pieces.refs: GT7 rain (Tokyo, Spa) and FH5 storm gameplay frames.

pieces.title: Title & front-end hub
pieces.scenario: Cold boot to title (attract), press A, main hub menu, starter-car choice; every screen's first frame and one transition mid-frame.
pieces.refs: FH5 title/Festival menu and GT7 title/world-map menu screenshots.

pieces.title: Garage, dealer, tuning & upgrade screens
pieces.scenario: Navigate by pad into each screen: garage, dealer, upgrade, tuning, paint, events, records, settings, controller, pause menu.
pieces.refs: FH5 garage/upgrade/tuning/paint menus and GT7 tuning shop/dealership/settings menus.

pieces.title: Engine & world audio
pieces.scenario: On-device audio capture (WAV) of a full-throttle run through the gears, lift-off, idle, limiter, tyre squeal and wind for 3 engine types (I4 turbo, rotary, I6 twin-turbo). Spectrograms + objective analysis.
pieces.refs: Reference engine recordings/spectra for the same engine types (GT7/FH5 captures or real-car recordings).

pieces.title: Handling & physics feel
pieces.scenario: Scripted inputs on device with telemetry: 0-100 launch, step steer at 80 km/h, lift-off in a corner, threshold braking, handbrake drift entry and sustain; plus chase-view frames of weight transfer.
pieces.refs: Published real-car / GT7 performance data for comparable cars and FH5/GT7 footage of equivalent manoeuvres.

pieces.title: Race experience: AI, race HUD, start & results
pieces.scenario: Start a sprint and a circuit race on device: grid/countdown, first corner pack, mid-race overtakes, finish, results screen.
pieces.refs: FH5 and GT7 race start, mid-race pack and results screens.

pieces.title: Traffic & world life
pieces.scenario: Free roam city and expressway, day and night: traffic density, lane behaviour, vehicle variety, near-miss.
pieces.refs: FH5 traffic in city/highway and GT7 Tokyo Expressway traffic-like scenes.

pieces.title: Map, minimap & navigation
pieces.scenario: World map screen (zoomed out and in, event markers, route set) and minimap crop while driving with a route.
pieces.refs: FH5 world map and minimap/GPS; GT7 world map menu.

pieces.title: Police pursuit
pieces.scenario: Trigger a pursuit in free roam: police car look, lightbar at night, chase behaviour, HUD heat indicator.
pieces.refs: FH/NFS-style police pursuit frames (FH5 has none, so use NFS Heat/Unbound as the AAA bar) and GT7 night car lighting.

pieces.title: Performance, frame pacing & load times
pieces.scenario: On device: cold boot to title time, title to driving time, 5-minute drive through the densest district logging fps, 1% lows, frame-time spikes, thermal headroom.
pieces.refs: FH5 / GT7 60 fps performance-mode frame-time behaviour and load-time benchmarks (Digital Foundry).
